description: Tests first: adapt redirect tests to alias arrays/history, protected attrs, old-ID query, chains inherited aliases in hard mode, history nameless channel priority/fallback, survivor deletion, validation rollback, generic owner CRUD used independently. Owners: Person schema, People delegate, new PersonMerger all policy/locking/queries; generic Permission CRUD and NotificationLog recipient update only; existing routing upsert/delete and conversation update. Remove all merge wrappers/filter churn. No JSON rewrites. Real DB tests/property/concurrency, no mocks. Schema migration replaces unapplied redirect migration; disposable test DB rollback permitted. Docs identity semantics.

comments.text: Final review fixed additional ordinary alias paths: bulk delete resolves/deduplicates aliases; conversation/routing/channel owner updates accept alias IDs; PersonMerger deletes losers via ordinary People.delete_person. Stable row locks use ID order, channel priority sorting happens after locking. Found/reproduced advisory-lock deadlock with async document-schema fixtures: ordinary person creation waited on global merge lock. Removed inherited tombstone-era locking wrappers from normal profile/channel/delete writes; PersonMerger.resource_transaction only takes merge lock for a merge request, before fields mutate. Added independent-connection regression proving ordinary person creation completes while unrelated merge lock is held. Opposing merges remain serialized with one self-merge rejection. Failing seed 278855 now passes full related coverage suite.

title: [zaq-h8q.3] Implement protected aliases and focused merger with ordinary owner APIs
